remaining_bottlenecks_measured.cause: WP_Query with post__in over 1266 (PT) / ~3200 (EN) event IDs, joined with the Polylang term relationship and the _event_status meta gate
remaining_bottlenecks_measured.left_unchanged_because: narrowing the ID set or caching the paginated result changes published ordering/pagination semantics and needs its own invalidation matrix; out of scope for a reviewable patch

remaining_bottlenecks_measured.cause: one WP_Query takes ~1.0 s of the ~1.1 s render: post__in over ~1300 event IDs joined with wp_term_relationships and the _event_status postmeta, LIMIT 2 (the hero/featured events slot)
remaining_bottlenecks_measured.left_unchanged_because: the candidate list must stay whole because the query itself applies the status/language filters; slicing it before the query would change which events are selected
